datasets.name: Conveyor open-loop step test (synthetic)
datasets.description: Open-loop command step 0.30 to 0.45 at t = 1 s on the BeltConveyor model with a 10 kg payload. The measured speed adds Gaussian noise and encoder quantisation to the true simulated speed. Generated, not measured.

columns.name: v_true_m_s
columns.description: Simulated belt speed before the sensor. A real experiment would not have this column.

columns.name: v_meas_m_s
columns.description: Belt speed with noise (sigma 0.003 m/s) and 0.002 m/s quantisation

limitations: Synthetic: the plant model and the noise model are assumptions of this repository.
Illustrative parameters, not identified from a conveyor.
Identification quality on this file says nothing about identification on real data.
